tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250thugs dam zab pa skor bdun gyi gsol 'debs bzhugs so// 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun bzang rigs lnga rdor 'chang rdo rje sems// dga' rab rdo rje mkhas pa shrī siṃ// o rgyan pad+ma mnga' bdag yab sras dang*// rig 'dzin chen po gar gyi dbang phyug la// gsol ba 'debs so mngon sum byin gyis rlobs// nyams snang gong du 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs// rig pa tshad la pheb par byin gyis rlobs// chos nyid zad sar skyol bar byin gyis rlobs// sku gsum gdod ma'i klong du sangs rgyas shog /

ces pa 'di gung thang bka' bcu pa chos 'byor dpal bzang sogs slob ma mang zhig gis bskul ngor/ bdag 'dra gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis thun mtshams su bgyis pa'o// 'di nyid kyi yi ge pa ni dhe ba'i ming can gyis snang rtse mchod khang du bris pa'o// //
